Refund, Returns & Dispute Resolution Policy

This policy explains how buyer protection, escrow, returns, refunds, and disputes are handled on Shopyos.

Last updated: August 19, 2026

1. Buyer Protection & Escrow

  • Shopyos protects buyers by holding all payments in escrow until the order is successfully fulfilled.

2. Conditions for Returns & Refunds

  • Buyers are entitled to request a refund or return under the following circumstances:
  • The item was not delivered.
  • The item arrived damaged or defective.
  • The item received is significantly different from the product description or photos listed by the vendor.
  • The wrong item, size, or color was delivered.

3. The Inspection Window

  • Upon receiving an order, buyers have a 48-hour inspection window to report any issues, defects, or non-compliance.
  • If no issue is reported within this timeframe, the order is marked as successfully completed, and the funds are released to the vendor.

4. How to Request a Refund / Raise a Dispute

  • Report the Issue: Buyers must initiate a return/refund request via their Shopyos dashboard within 48 hours of delivery, providing clear photographic evidence and a description of the issue.
  • Funds Frozen: Upon raising a dispute, the funds associated with that order are immediately frozen in escrow.
  • Mediation: The Shopyos Mediation Team will review the evidence provided by both the buyer and the vendor (including dispatch proofs and product photos).
  • Resolution (Buyer): If resolved in the buyer's favor, the buyer must return the item to the vendor (shipping terms to be mediated based on fault). Once returned, a full refund will be routed back to the buyer's original payment method via our payment gateway (Paystack).
  • Resolution (Vendor): If resolved in the vendor's favor, the dispute will be closed, and the escrowed funds will be released to the vendor's settlement balance.

5. Pre-Fulfillment Cancellations

  • If an order is canceled by either the buyer or the vendor before the item has been dispatched, a full refund is automatically processed back to the buyer’s original payment method.
